## Source: amazon-inspector (91bd1a5cb0c3bacb52c303b598c520dff6f40695affdb1643dd502cf3981d797)
The gem's native-extension script extconf.rb base64-decodes an embedded Ruby payload, writes it to a randomized file under the system temp directory, and spawns a detached `ruby` process on it before invoking mkmf's `create_makefile`. The decoded payload opens a TCP connection to the hardcoded bare IP 45.138.12.177 on port 8089 and bridges the socket bidirectionally to `/bin/sh`, giving the remote endpoint interactive command execution on the installing host. The payload loops with a 30-second sleep to re-dial on disconnect, providing persistent reconnection. The C2 destination is concealed as a base64 literal rather than appearing in plaintext, and the behavior is unrelated to any native build step.
